name: Chimera Lab evolution benchmark
note: S5. The 11 fixed cases the agent and the fixed pipeline are scored on. This file never changes; a test checks its hash. Scores are computed in code (app/evolution/benchmark.py) from the saved results.

scores.full_match: every critic item passes (no failure or uncertain row in the final image's inspect)
scores.critic_failures: count of failing rows, split into structure (structure group), identity (identity group) and integration (integration, coverage, placement, pattern, connection groups)
scores.identity: for each parent: does the deciding critic's (Meta Spark, D-084) 'which animals' answer name that parent (its full common name or its last word); Spark Open's answer is kept as information
scores.cost: renders, edits, tool calls (agent only), calls per provider and wall time per creature
